description: This file defines the final class 'Warn' within the 'ScssPhp\ScssPhp' namespace. It provides static methods for issuing warnings and deprecation notices related to SCSS processing, including setting callback handlers for warning reporting.

classes.name: Warn
classes.description: A utility class for issuing warnings and deprecation notices within the SCSSPHP compiler, allowing customization of warning handling via callbacks.

methods.name: warning
methods.description: Public static method to print a warning message, intended to be called within custom functions or importers.

methods.name: deprecation
methods.description: Public static method to print a deprecation warning message.

methods.name: setCallback
methods.description: Sets a callback function to handle warning reports, returning the previous callback.

methods.name: reportWarning
methods.description: Private method that calls the registered warning callback with the message and deprecation flag.
